step3.title: TOU pricing
step3.noRules: No rate windows defined — every booking uses the base price. Click Add rate window to start.
step3.tipText: Raising the rate for the 18:00 – 21:00 window could lift monthly revenue by up to 15%.

step3.deleteConfirmModalDesc: Are you sure you want to delete rate window "{{name}}" ({{from}}–{{to}})? Bookings falling into these hours will revert to the base price.

step4.title: Availability & Operational Standards
step4.lockDesc: System automatically cancels holding and frees connector after 15 mins if driver fails to check in.
step4.advanceDesc: Only opens reservations for Today and Tomorrow (~48h) to ensure schedule stability.
step4.validConfigHelp: All operational policies are standardized across the platform according to ChargeOps SLA.
step4.bufferDesc: Mandatory safety interval after each session for departure before the next booking arrives.
step4.philosophyTitle: Core Operational Principles: Reservations & Real Charging Sessions
step4.philosophyBooking: Reservations are commitments: Guaranteed time slots with drivers. Early completions create safe buffers without advancing downstream schedules.
step4.philosophyBuffer: 10-minute buffer is vehicle exchange time: Ensures departing car unplugs and clears space before arriving car enters.
step4.philosophyOverstay: Drivers overstaying: Subject to separate idle fees, never unilaterally pushing back downstream reservations.
step4.philosophySchedule: Schedule applies to new bookings: Configuration changes apply only to bookings created after saving; confirmed bookings retain original commitments.
step4.philosophyBookingText: Guaranteed time slots with drivers. Early completions create safe buffers without advancing downstream schedules.
step4.philosophyBufferText: Ensures departing car unplugs and clears space before arriving car enters.
step4.philosophyOverstayText: Subject to separate idle fees, never unilaterally pushing back downstream reservations.
step4.philosophyScheduleText: Configuration changes apply only to bookings created after saving; confirmed bookings retain original commitments.

open247.item1Desc: Ensure entry gates and parking barriers are not locked after 22:00. Drivers can book and access freely at night (01:00 – 05:00 AM).
open247.item2Desc: If a driver arrives with a valid booking but cannot access or the station is closed, an SLA violation is recorded affecting your platform rating.
open247.item3Desc: Night hours (22:00 – 04:00) feature the lowest EVN grid electricity tariffs. We recommend adding off-peak rates in Step 3 to maximize margin.
